sentence: Feed a frenemy your sasslit and watch them feast on nothing.

wombos.definition: The state of having been successfully sasslighted — left questioning your own confidence and aura after an encounter with someone of overwhelming wit and boldness.
wombos.example: I walked out of that conversation completely sasslit.

wombos.definition: A person who acts as a friend but is simultaneously a rival or adversary — someone whose friendship is tinged with competition or hostility.
wombos.example: She congratulates me every time I win, but I know she's my frenemy.
